notes:
- **The Workshop: Pioneer Access**: The Workshop opens in stages. Until it fully opens, you'll find our announcement and a short poll on the Workshop page - vote for what you'd like to see first, and change your vote any time. Posting, comments and messages open with the full launch.
- **"Connection Lost" is fixed by itself**: when a test game stops with "Network Protocol Error" (the client and server disagree about a packet), the app now reads the report Minecraft writes, finds the packet that failed and the real cause, and the Assistant repairs the mod right away - just like a crash.
- **Repairs use the right crash report**: an automatic repair now only uses reports from the run that just failed, never an older one left in the project.
- **Better textures that match your mod**: MyPixelAI now knows what each asset is - its in-game name, what it does and how the mod's related textures look - so a set (like tier 1 and tier 2 cables) keeps the same style, outline and palette.
- **Cleaner 3D models**: the 3D Studio checks every model the AI makes for floating parts, wrong sizes and loose pivots and has them fixed before saving, and animations loop smoothly without a jump at the end.
- **Delete a project completely**: deleting a project on the start screen now also removes all of MyCraftingAI's data for it.
- **Policies**: the [Terms of Service](https://mycraftingai.com/terms.html) and [Privacy Policy](https://mycraftingai.com/privacy.html) now explain clearly how AI processing works, payments through Dodo Payments and virus scanning in The Workshop.
